mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz.inbound_cmd ( pallet_id, task_id, sku_code, lot_id, qty, expire_date, status, received_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{palletId}, #{taskId}, #{skuCode}, #{lotId}, #{qty}, #{expireDate}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (pallet_id) DO UPDATE SET task_id = EXCLUDED.task_id, sku_code = EXCLUDED.sku_code, lot_id = EXCLUDED.lot_id, qty = EXCLUDED.qty, expire_date = EXCLUDED.expire_date, status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE biz.inbound_cmd SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE pallet_id = #{palletId}
